notes: «قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ» : the question is in the first person and its asker is not named in the text; the Imam answers («قَالَ يُؤَدَّبُ»). Whether the first-person asker is a link is a case for a ruling (rule 11); he is not added
the Imam written inside the chain after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2); «عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» is a blessing
